stem.text: A dendrograph records changes in the diameter of a tree. The diagram shows a dendrograph fixed to a tree.
Some results are shown on the chart recording.

stem.alt: Diagram of a dendrograph fixed around a tree trunk, with the labels tree and chart.
Chart recording with the vertical axis labelled diameter and the horizontal axis labelled time of day, marked 1200, 2400, 1200, 2400 and 1200, with a wavy curve.

stem.text: What explains the diameter changes recorded during the day and night?

A.text: Adhesion forces decrease during the night.

B.text: Cohesive tension forces increase during the day.

C.text: Mass flow of sucrose increases during the night.

D.text: Root pressure decreases during the day.
